name: smooth-caret-input

frames.best_why: The top field holds 'pricing table' with the white custom caret resting at the end, beside the native field.

tagline: Two text fields compare a gliding custom caret against a plain native one.
summary: A pair of text inputs, one with a spring-animated caret that slides to each new spot and a plain input for comparison, so you can feel the difference while typing.
appearance: Two wide dark rounded fields stack under a small uppercase label. The top one is taller with large light text and a slim white caret bar; the lower one holds smaller grey placeholder text.
behaviour: Focusing the top field reveals an outline, and typing makes the white caret glide to the new character instead of blinking at a jump. The native field below shows the ordinary caret for comparison.
demo_content: Placeholders 'Search projects…' and 'Native caret'; typed text 'pricing table' and 'Ship it on Friday'.
search_phrases: text input with smooth sliding caret
animated cursor in a search field
use_when: A search or command field is a focal point and a gliding caret adds a subtle polish.
avoid_when: The caret is a custom bar measured from the text, so long strings or unusual fonts can drift out of alignment.
customise: All normal input props pass through plus type, font size, a wrapper class and caret spring tuning; the measuring and scroll logic stays internal.
weight_why: One input plus a measured span and a spring value that runs only while the caret moves.

a11y.note: The native input keeps full keyboard and screen reader behaviour; the custom caret is decorative and snaps under reduced motion.

props.name: spring
props.type: { stiffness: number; damping: number; mass: number }

polish_why: The gliding caret is convincing and the comparison layout is clear; it is a small effect.
